content.introduction: The economic sector performance dashboards on Yahoo Finance show varying YTD returns for different sectors as of today's date. The Technology sector has a YTD return of 9.76%, 19.16%, and 17.68% across the three sources. Healthcare leads with a YTD return of 21.75%, 24.73%, and 21.53%. Industrials show the highest YTD return at 31.97%, 39.30%, and 42.22%. Communication Services has the worst performance with YTD returns of -11.09%, -8.60%, and -12.11%. The sources also provide day returns for each sector, with Industrials showing the largest negative day return at -5.24%, and Utilities the largest positive at +0.31%.
